extraction_notes: Ursodiol and prednisone (current) for autoimmune hepatitis/PSC are comorbidity treatments excluded from the Crohn's treatment list. Azathioprine is listed as it is an immunomodulator used for autoimmune hepatitis but also relevant to IBD management context; however, patient attributes it to autoimmune hepatitis — included as it is an IBD-class drug used in this patient's overlapping immunosuppression regimen. Remicade was stopped at age 22 when all medications were halted due to liver enzyme elevation; it is unclear if it was the direct cause. The transcript ends with a natural concluding statement ('That's all I can do. Has to be enough.') — marked complete.
